verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an identity provider like Entra ID. However, the evidence pack never documents an employee-facing app launcher dashboard or browser extension. The only related items cover SSO to cloud resources via device join and admin-side gallery app SSO configuration; these are adjacent features, not the portal the story asks for.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned
